The '''sister''' of [[Esano]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] whose family ran the [[Kozinarg Trade Guilds]]. She was kidnapped by members of [[the Scourge]] and taken to the icy [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Orto Norwe]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] brothers [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] freed her, but then held her hostage to distract the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Unidentified task force (Plo Koon)|task force]] that was trying to [[Skirmish on Orto Norwe|apprehend]] them. After evading the Jedi and bringing her to her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Pleem's Nexus]], for a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Maul and Opress [[Skirmish on Pleem's Nexus|slew]] her brother and his security forces when he told them to kill his sister and make him the only heir to their family's fortune. She then gave them access to her family's vault, but they left it behind when the arrival of the Jedi from Yellowblade's Landing forced them to leave the planet.<ref name="The Sith Hunters" />
